Rank: S-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: Self (60-Foot Cone) Duration: Instant Components: W (Any Blade), M, CM Cost: 28 Chakra Keywords: Bukijutsu, Chain, Clash Description: As part of the requirements for casting this jutsu, your weapon must be under the effects of a jutsu that would provide it an increase to damage in any way, such as the jutsu Lightning Release: Lightning Kings Mantle, or Fire Release: Flame Coat, etc.
You take your already enhanced weapon and funnel more powerful chakra within it, causing it to radiate intense black chakra before releasing it as a wave of black chakra filling a 60-foot cone. All creatures within range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Weapon's damage] + 4d12 damage of the damage type of the jutsu that buffs your damage and has their maximum hit points reduced by the damage dealt for the next minute on a failed save, or half much damage on a success. Rank: B-Rank Casting Time: 1 Reaction when you take damage from a Weapon, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu Range: Weapon range Duration: Instant
Components: W (Any Blade), M Cost: 12 Chakra Keywords: Bukijutsu, Chain Description: You seek to emulate the power of one of the Seven Deadly Sins of Humanity in your blade, imbuing the Sin of Pride inside the edge. When you would take damage, roll your weapons damage+4d6 and reduce the damage by the rolled amount as you parry some or all of the impact. If you reduce the damage to 0, the triggering creature gains a rank of Demoralized.
Chain 2: Your pride is so fervent that not even illusions are immune to your defense. This jutsu can also trigger when you take Psychic damage, reducing the damage as if this jutsu were a Genjutsu.
At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost by 3 and the damage reduction by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher some of the impact can be redirected to hostile creatures. Hostile creatures of your choice within 5 feet of you take damage equal to half the result. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank and reduces the triggering damage to 0, then all hostile creatures within 20 feet of you becomes Demoralized.

Rank: C-Rank
Casting Time: 1 Reaction, which you take when you would take damage from a melee attack.
Range: Weapons Range
Duration: Instant
Components: W (Any Blade), M
Cost: 7 Chakra
Keywords: Bukijutsu, Chain
Description: You use your weapon to get around your opponent’s guard as they attack, and then bring it up in an attempt to disarm them, literally. You increase your AC by +2. If the triggering attack misses, you can make a melee taijutsu attack. On a hit you deal your [Weapons damage] + 3d8 and the triggering creature must make a Strength Saving throw. On a failed save, you disarm them of their weapon and take hold of it in an open hand. If you do not have a hand free, you throw it 10 feet in a direction of your choice.
Chain 1: This can be used against a ranged attack as well, where if the triggering attack misses, you can make a ranged taijutsu attack, and throw their attack back at them, making the triggering creature the new target for the jutsu’s attack and effects.
Chain 2: A creature who has their weapon disarmed from them is also knocked Prone.

jutsuBookImport.sourceText:
Rank: A-Rank Casting Time: 1 Full Turn Action  Range: Self
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Components: W (5 of Any Blades), M Cost: 19 Chakra
Keywords: Bukijutsu Description: You hold 5 of your weapons in the gaps between your armpits, the hinge joints of your arms and legs, and various other places; before placing a final Tanto in your mouth, leaving your hands completely free. This jutsu allows for quick and unpredictable attacks, that catch your enemies off-guard. While under the effects of this jutsu, you cannot concentrate on any other jutsu.
This jutsu provides you the following benefits;
melee weapon attacks you make cannot be reacted to.
As a reaction you can deflect an attack against you, adding +5 to your AC against the triggering attack. If this would cause the attack to miss, you can make a melee weapon attack as a part of the same reaction, as long as the target is within range.
As a bonus action, you can make 2 melee weapon attacks.
As an action you can take the dash action and make 3 melee weapon attacks.
As a full turn action, you make use of all of your weapons and strike with them. Make five melee weapon attacks, once with each weapon. If they all hit, the creature is Stunned until the end of their next turn.
All of these benefits are only applicable while using Tanto. Switching to a different weapon or even holding a weapon that is not a Tanto will automatically end this jutsu.

jutsuBookImport.sourceText:
Rank: S-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: Self
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 Minute Components: W (Any Blade), M Cost: Special (20 Chakra) Keywords: Bukijutsu, Stable Description: You must be under the effects of a Sword Aura: Secondary to cast this jutsu. When you cast this jutsu, you end concentration of Sword Aura: Secondary as this jutsu takes its place. At the beginning of each of your turns, select one of the listed monochrome colors which your weapons color shifts to match, gaining the listed effects.
Black:  Your weapons damage type becomes Necrotic. Additionally, damage your weapon deals cannot be healed for 1 minute unless by a S-Rank jutsu.
White: Your weapons damage type becomes Psychic. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with this weapon, they must make a Charisma saving throw becoming Inverted on a failed save.
[BOX]
| Sword Aura: Monochrome - Inverted. / An inverted creature has parts of their body which was struck seemingly painted over as those colors are shifted to be the opposite on the color spectrum. An inverted creature loses its inversion status at the end of each of their turns. An Inverted creature suffers the following effects. / Inverse Strengths. Their Ninjutsu ability score becomes Wisdom. Their Taijutsu Ability score becomes Intelligence and their Genjutsu Ability score becomes Strength for the duration. / Inverse Defense. Their AC is used in place of all saving throw bonuses. Their highest Saving throw bonus is used in place of their AC. |
[/BOX]

rules.text: Bonus action, concentration: pick a color. Red: fire, a failed save against your Bukijutsu: Prone. Blue: cold, failed save: −10 speed until the end of your next turn. Yellow: lightning, constructs and structures vulnerable, failed save: it loses concentration on its lowest-rank jutsu.

jutsuBookImport.sourceText:
Rank: C-Rank Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action Range: Self Duration: Concentration, up to 1 Minute Components: W (Any Blade), M Cost: 8 Chakra Keywords: Bukijutsu, Stable Description: You begin to focus on the ability to create a Sword Aura. You send a controlled flood of chakra into your sword, the striking portion flaring a color of your choice. Select a primary color for your weapon to embody.
Red. Your weapons damage type becomes Fire, and a creature who fails a saving throw as a result of a Bukijutsu you cast, falls Prone from its explosive force.
Blue. Your weapons damage type becomes cold, and a creature that fails a saving throw as a result of a Bukijutsu you cast, reduces their speed by 10 feet, until the end of your next turn.
Yellow. Your weapons damage type becomes lightning, constructs and structures are vulnerable to your [Weapon damage], and when a creature fails a saving throw as a result of a Bukijutsu you cast, they lose concentration on the lowest rank jutsu they are maintaining. If they are maintaining concentration on more than one jutsu of the same rank, they lose concentration on one at random.

rules.text: Replaces Sword Aura: Primary (concentration). Each turn pick: Green (cold or lightning; −10 speed; constructs and structures vulnerable), Orange (fire or lightning; push 5 feet; constructs and structures vulnerable), Purple (fire or cold; push 5 feet; −10 speed).

jutsuBookImport.sourceText:
Rank: A-Rank Casting Time: Special Range: Self Duration: Special Components: W (Any Blade), M Cost: Special (15 Chakra)
Keywords: Bukijutsu, Stable Description: You must be under the effects of a Sword Aura: Primary to cast this jutsu. When you cast this jutsu, you end concentration of Sword Aura: Primary as this jutsu takes its place. At the beginning of each of your turns, select one of the listed secondary colors which your weapons color shifts to match, gaining the listed effects.
Green:  Your weapons damage type becomes either Cold or Lightning which you choose each time you deal damage with it. Additionally, a creature you deal damage to with this weapon reduces their speed by 10 feet until the beginning of your next turn and treats constructs and structures as vulnerable to its damage.
Orange: Your weapons damage type becomes either Fire or Lightning which you choose each time you deal damage with it. Additionally, a creature you deal damage to with this weapon can be pushed 5 feet into a direction of your choice (except upwards) and treats constructs and structures as vulnerable to its damage.
Purple: Your weapons damage type becomes either Fire or Cold which you choose each time you deal damage with it. Additionally, a creature you deal damage to with this weapon can be pushed 5 feet into a direction of your choice (except upwards) and reduces their speed by 10 feet until the beginning of your next turn.

rules.text: Concentration: one benefit for your weapon (Chain 2: two): no disadvantage on its attacks; its damage ignores resistance; treats immunity as resistance; ignores temporary hit points.

Rank: D-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: Self (15-foot cone) Duration: Instant
Components: W (Any Blade), M Cost: 4 Chakra Keywords: Bukijutsu, Chain Description: You swing your weapon with enough force to create a lateral wave of cutting force. Creatures in a 15-foot cone originating from you, must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save you deal your [Weapons damage] + 1d12 or half as much on a successful one.
Chain 1: Creatures who are within 5 feet of you when you cast this jutsu make their save at disadvantage.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d12 and the range by 5 feet.
